title: Family at Hoover Dam Nevada, Reservoir View - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
location: Hoover Dam, Clark County, Nevada, United States
description: A well-dressed family poses against a concrete parapet wall overlooking a massive canyon lake, likely Hoover Dam's Lake Mead in the late 1930s. The family includes two women in fashionable brimmed hats and dresses, a young girl with curled hair in a Peter Pan-collared dress, and a bald gentleman smartly attired in a tailored three-piece suit and necktie. The reverse shows black paper residue at the corners from an old scrapbook album alongside faint photographic paper watermarks.
